column1: # PR E's attribution file: the pixels the move of the Settings pages' buttons, strips, badge and empty-state icon (Task 13) to Ely
# changes. Format and meaning: docs/testing/bezel-off.md ("The allow table"). Each why starts with the first cell of the spec's
# inventory row that explains the change.
# Twelve frames change (the Agents, Git hosting accounts, Git hosting and Language servers pages, the last in three pages, each in dark
# and light), and each row below is that frame's whole changed box, read from changed.tsv of the diff against PR D's after set. No
# frame draws what Task 13 also changed (the status bar's usage meter, the clone form's progress bar, the turn preview's rewind
# button), and removing the crates (Task 14) moves no pixel: the same set differs from Task 13's final head by nothing.

column6: widgets::Buttons::button (the Agents page's Update, Update All, Refresh and Install: bezel's ButtonStyle buttons became Ely Buttons at Sm, Outline for Update and Update All, Ghost for Refresh, Primary for Install, so each is larger or smaller than before, Ghost has no border and the rows and the toolbar reflow; the box is the page's whole changed region, because the registry strip above the card is 6 px taller and everything below it shifts)

widgets::Status (the registry-error strip and the install-failure strip: bezel's warning_strip and error_strip became Ely Alerts, Warning and Danger, taller, with Ely's severity icon, no border and Base text; the registry strip's extra 6 px moves the card below it)
widgets::Content (the Installed badge on Claude Code: bezel's badge_active became Ely's Success Badge, with larger, bolder text on a squarer tint)
